open_objections: The perturbation formula r_E(A_mu)=1-mu lambda_min(S_C)+o(mu) passed an independent hostile reconstruction but is not yet independently rederived at E5.
The former universal boundary target S_C>=2I is exactly refuted by the n=8 two-pole/simplex-ring matrix from Iteration 4.
The reduction itself remains valid and transfers that boundary failure to an exact finite positive-mu refutation of C026.
The best possible positive dimension-uniform replacement constant remains open; current analytic families approach 3/2 from above.
